turnos.t: Can a host country set the rules for multinationals?

The United Arab Emirates does. Since June 2021, foreigners can own one hundred percent of companies in most activities, which attracts investment. From 2023, business profits above a threshold are taxed at nine percent, so the government keeps a share.
Emiratisation. Private firms with fifty or more staff must raise the share of Emiratis in skilled jobs by two percent a year, to ten percent by the end of 2026, or pay fines.
